items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I remember it being Herdick and Seamons.

ctx.x: it was still Herdick and Seamon Seamon and Herdick, so this was before the Shifmans took it over and before it got a black policy. They obviously had tried out having black shows there. Do you remember any of this?
No. No. No. I remember it being Herdick and Seamons. I remember that. That was a big name in burlesque at that time.
Yeah. But this was when the Shifmans owned the Lafayette.
